result.solution: Badilisha spark plugs zote 4/6 kwa pamoja na ukague ignition coils
actions: Ondoa spark plugs na kukagua umbo la electrode
Badilisha spark plugs mpya za factory spec
Futa misfiring code kisha jaribu gari tena
Kagua ignition coils kama misfiring inaendelea

result.diagnosis: Catalyst efficiency chini ya kikomo (P0420) au O2 sensor
result.solution: Kagua O2 sensor na catalyst; badilisha O2 sensor kama imelemewa
actions: Scan code tena na kagua live data ya O2 sensor
Kisia upstream/downstream O2 sensor voltages
Badilisha O2 sensor kama mabadiliko ni mabaya
Chunguza exhaust leak kabla ya kubadilisha catalyst

result.diagnosis: Brake pads zimeisha (metal backing imegusa rotor)
result.solution: Badilisha brake pads na kusawazisha rotors
actions: Punguza brake pads na kukagua unene wa rotor
Badilisha brake pads za mbele (na za nyuma kama zimeisha)
Resurface au badilisha rotors kama zimejaa mfinyanzi
Fanya brake bleeding baada ya kazi

result.diagnosis: Head gasket imewaka au coolant inaingia kwenye combustion chamber
result.solution: Compression test kisha badilisha head gasket na kusawazisha cylinder head
actions: Kagua coolant level na test ya combustion leak (block tester)
Fanya compression test kwa silinda zote
Badilisha head gasket na mill cylinder head kama inahitajika
Badilisha coolant na bleeding ya cooling system

result.diagnosis: Air filter na/au injectors zinafanya kazi vibaya
result.solution: Badilisha air filter, safisha injectors na ukague fuel trim
actions: Badilisha air filter
Safisha injectors (juice au ultrasonic)
Kagua fuel trim data kwenye OBD (STFT/LTFT)
Kagua tyre pressure na alignment kama ndio chanzo

result.solution: Badilisha battery na kagua charging system
actions: Kagua voltage ya battery (chini ya 12.4V = imelemewa)
Fanya load test ya battery
Charge au badilisha battery
Kagua alternator output (13.8V - 14.4V)

result.solution: Kagua relay ya fuel pump na fuel pump current; badilisha kama imekufa
actions: Sikiliza fuel pump kwa kuwasha kuwali (prime) sekunde 2
Kagua fuse na relay ya fuel pump
Kagua voltage kwenye fuel pump connector
Badilisha fuel pump kama hakuna pressure
